question: Do the two initial unchanged rankings authorize opening the already frozen next-frame RGB observation without target truth?

evaluation.truth_role: IoU is reported only after the trigger decision and never enters trigger_value or action_authorized.

final_outcome_gates.wrong_top1_recovery: If at least one initial view has wrong Top-1 while target Recall@3 is 2/2, require the triggered action view to put the target at Top-1 with IoU at least 0.5 and positive Top-1-minus-Top-2 margin.
final_outcome_gates.margin_sharpening: If both initial views are already target Top-1, require the triggered action view to retain target Top-1, exceed the maximum initial margin, and exceed the latest initial Top-1 target IoU. This is weaker than wrong-instance recovery.
final_outcome_gates.no_trigger: If minimum initial margin is above 0.02, do not open action RGB; record the policy as a truthful no-action result.

next_action.triggered: Freeze an action-only scorer protocol that requires this trigger receipt, then open only FDV_action_query and apply the preregistered tiered outcome gates.
next_action.not_triggered: Do not open FDV_action_query. Retain the no-action result and move to the physical-door instance-head branch rather than changing the threshold.

forbidden_after_freeze: open FDV_action_query before this trigger receipt authorizes it
use IoU, target rank, target identity or future action outcome in the trigger
change the 0.02 threshold, action frame, action direction, one-action budget or tiered outcome gates
claim_boundary: This receipt can authorize one fixed RGB observation from initial score ambiguity only. It is not action success, a learned or deployable selector, calibrated uncertainty, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
